SYN-A.title: Synthetic Paper A: Conductivity of LLZO Solid Electrolyte (fabricated demo text)

paragraphs.p-0001: We synthesized Li7La3Zr2O12 (LLZO) pellets by a solid-state reaction and measured a total ionic conductivity of 3.2e-4 S/cm at 25 C.
paragraphs.p-0002: The LLZO green pellets were sintered at 1100 C for 12 h in a magnesia crucible.
paragraphs.p-0003: X-ray diffraction (XRD) confirmed the cubic garnet phase of the LLZO pellets.
paragraphs.p-0004: We trained a random forest model (RF-A) on the SynthIon-1 dataset to predict ionic conductivity, achieving an R2 of 0.81.
paragraphs.p-0005: Compared with LATP (Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3), LLZO shows better stability against lithium metal.

SYN-B.title: Synthetic Paper B: Ta-Doped LLZO and a Second Conductivity Dataset (fabricated demo text)

paragraphs.p-0001: Lithium lanthanum zirconium oxide (LLZO, Li7La3Zr2O12) is a promising solid electrolyte, and we report a conductivity of 1.1e-3 S/cm for Ta-doped LLZO at 25 C.
paragraphs.p-0002: The Ta-doped LLZO samples were sintered at 1230 C for 2 h in air.
paragraphs.p-0003: XRD patterns indicate a cubic garnet structure for all sintered samples.
paragraphs.p-0004: We used the SynthIon-2 dataset and trained a random forest model (RF-B) to predict ionic conductivity, reaching an R2 of 0.74.
paragraphs.p-0005: Under our test conditions, LLZO outperforms LATP (Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3) in critical current density.
